bio: I am a full stack developer with more than three years of experience building end-to-end web and mobile applications. I work across React, React Native, Flutter, Java Spring Boot, REST APIs, databases, and AWS, with a strong focus on secure, maintainable delivery.

My work includes a fintech platform with Flutter mobile apps, a React administration portal, and a Spring Boot backend; Digac, a Flutter and Firebase crypto tracker; Mantis Bug Tracker, a React Native collaboration app; and a Python machine-learning project for credit card fraud detection.

I am completing an M.Sc. in Software Security and Engineering at the University of Genoa, where my thesis focuses on automatic anonymization of user data using virtualization techniques. I am looking for full stack roles, apprenticeships, traineeships, freelance work, and opportunities to grow my professional network.

experience.summary: Build React web applications, Flutter mobile applications for Android and iOS, and fintech backend features with Spring Boot, REST APIs, AWS, and CI/CD.
Developed React Native features and REST API integrations, built an OAuth2/JWT SSO portal, improved database performance by about 40%, and supported a Flutter migration.
Built Flutter mobile applications, reusable UI components, API integrations, and Flutter plugins that reduced repetitive development effort by about 20%.
Built responsive websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python and assisted with C# desktop application development.
